sentences.text: Shri Anshu Gupta - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Prabhakar Kushwah - Panel Lawyer for the respondent
Heard on I.A.No.27585/2024, an application under Section 397(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the petitioner.

This revision has been preferred by the petitioner against judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 24.12.2024 passed by the First Additional Sessions Judge, Jaura, Distt. Morena (M.P.) in Criminal Appeal No.19/2020 affirming the judgment dated 24.12.2019 passed by the JMFC, Jaura, Distt. Morena in Criminal Case No. 301078/2009 whereby the petitioner has been convicted under Section 16(1)(A)(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo 03 months' imprisonment with fine of Rs.2000/- with default stipulation.

entities.text: First Additional Sessions Judge, Jaura, Distt. Morena
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner argued that the Courts below have wrongly appreciated the evidence and convicted the petitioner.
It is further submitted that the petitioner was on bail during trial and he never misused the liberty.
It is further submitted that petitioner is permanent resident of District Morena (M.P.).
Petitioner has suffered sufficient incarceration.
Fine amount has already been deposited.
Present criminal revision is likely to take long time to conclude.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the petitioner be released on bail.

On the other hand, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the petitioner and prayed for its rejection.
In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the application (I.A. No. 27585/2024) is allowed.

It is directed that petitioner shall deposit the entire fine amount, if not already deposited and furnish personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety Ravi Goyal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 30 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191600076/
1 in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.

List in due course.
